description: Use this when the user wants people to claim slots: potluck dishes, volunteer shifts, carpool seats, snack turns. It publishes a shared page where each person enters a first name and picks slots; each slot has a capacity and a full slot cannot be taken. Returns a public link to share and a private organizer link. Slots may have dates and times (then give an IANA time_zone). Does not send emails or reminders and does not take payments.

host_name.description: Organizer display name shown on the sheet, e.g. Coach Lee.

max_per_person.description: How many slots one person may take, 1-60. Default 1. Example: 2.

note.description: Short note shown on the sheet, e.g. Please bring serving spoons.

show_names.description: Show first names on each slot to everyone with the link (helps avoid duplicate dishes). Default false. Example: true.

capacity.description: How many people this slot takes, 1-50. Default 1. Example: 3.

end.description: Optional end: HH:MM the same day (e.g. 12:00), or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, or for a date slot the last day YYYY-MM-DD.

label.description: What people sign up for, e.g. Main dish, Saturday 9-12 shift, Car seat to the game.

start.description: Optional local start YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, or a date YYYY-MM-DD, in time_zone, e.g. 2026-11-14T09:00.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone for slot dates and times, e.g. America/Chicago. Needed when any slot has a start.

title.description: Sheet title, e.g. Thanksgiving potluck or Food drive volunteer shifts.
